tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Find open government tenders (calls for bids) by what is being bought and, optionally, the country. Returns up to 10 live tenders from official procurement portals (refreshed daily) with buyer, deadline, value and an askTender link. Use when the user asks to find tenders, calls for bids or public co

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: The facts of one tender by its askTender id: title, buyer, country, deadline, value, status, and a plain-English brief where available, with its askTender link.

tools.name: can_company_bid
tools.description: Whether a company based in one country may bid for public tenders in another country (trade agreements, foreign-bidder rules, registrations needed). Give a tender_id or the tender's country. Use when the user asks whether a company from one country can bid on, or take part in, public tenders in anot

tools.name: find_guides
tools.description: askTender's guides on how public procurement works: registering on portals (SAM.gov, GeM, Find a Tender...), digital signatures, bid security, foreign bidders, consortiums. Returns titles, summaries and links.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: askTender's plans (Pro, Intelligence, Business): prices, what each includes, who each is for, and which fits the user's situation. Use when the user asks about pricing, which plan to choose, or what askTender can do for them.

tools.name: check_my_eligibility
tools.description: For the user's own company (askTender account): whether it can bid on a tender and qualifies, which requirements it meets, what is missing and how to close each gap. Needs the askTender account connected. Use when the user asks whether their own company qualifies for, or can bid on, a specific askTe

tools.name: get_requirements
tools.description: Every requirement of a tender in the tender's own words (financial, experience, certifications, registrations, bid security, documents), routed to who handles each. Pro plan and above.

tools.name: get_bid_kit
tools.description: The submission checklist for a tender against the user's company: documents they already have, drafts askTender prepares for signature, and items to obtain with lead times. Pro plan and above.

tools.name: my_matching_tenders
tools.description: Open tenders for the user's company: found by what its askTender profile says the company does (its capabilities), or by a search phrase if given. Use when the user asks which tenders suit or match their company.

tools.name: save_tender
tools.description: Save a tender to the user's askTender list (deadline reminders and tracking).

tools.name: my_saved_tenders
tools.description: The tenders the user has saved on askTender, with deadlines.

tools.name: tender_incumbent
tools.description: For a tender: who holds or last won this buyer's similar contracts, the buyer's closest past contracts (winner, value, date) and a price guide from them, useful when the notice publishes no value. Intelligence plan and above.

tools.name: watch
tools.description: Add a public buyer or a supplier (competitor) to the user's watchlist, to follow their tenders and awards. Intelligence plan and above.

tools.name: my_watchlist
tools.description: The buyers and competitors the user watches, with their recent activity. Intelligence plan and above.

tools.name: upcoming_renewals
tools.description: Contracts in the user's markets that are ending soon (the next tender is coming). Intelligence plan and above.

tools.name: start_managed_bid
tools.description: Hand a tender to the askTender Desk, which prepares the bid with the user and coordinates askTender Partners (accountants, professionals) for certificates and filing. Business plan.

tools.name: my_bids
tools.description: The user's bids being prepared with askTender and their status.

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: The user's askTender plan and what it includes.
